_doc: Per-fixture node-size ratchet for the state DOT-parity suite (decisions.md#d4, A4). Same convention as oracle/goldens/object/size-backlog.json: structurally EQUAL fixtures whose maxSizeDeltaIn (inches, max across their svek-N graphs) is not yet 0; the test asserts delta <= pinned + 1e-6 per graph, so deltas only shrink. Phase L size iterations drive entries to 0 and DELETE them (absent slug = 0 required). Captured 2026-07-11 at ratchet creation. skin-loading B2 note (nimana-36-veco708): the G8 tracked exception is RESOLVED. The skin-file-loading mission landed `skin <name>` stylesheet loading + state drop-shadow rendering/ink (skin rose Shadowing=4.0 now draws the filter and reserves 2*shadow=8px), so this entry improved 0.111111 -> 0.043169 (below its pre-G8 0.090278). The remaining 0.043169 is a pre-existing NON-shadow size gap on another svek graph of this fixture (a separate size-parity follow-up, not skin/shadow), pinned tighten-only here. INHERENT-TOLERANCE EXCLUSIONS (added 2026-08-10): corumi-91-mizo869 and gupeto-19-mesa256 are NOT defects and must not be driven to 0. Both carry the same <math>S<=1/(F+(1-F)/N)</math> label and both pin at the identical 1.106597, the signature of one shared inherent cause: <math> renders through KaTeX where the jar uses JLaTeXMath, a PERMANENT maintainer-approved divergence (DIVERGENCES.md, 'LaTeX rendering engine'). They stay pinned shrink-only for non-regression but are excluded from the conformant denominator, exactly as the description suite treats gevozu-46/sunuju-01. Before this note the state backlog had NO divergence language at all, so these two read as ordinary work items. TRANSITION-LABEL-INK RE-PIN (2026-08-15, mission plans/transition-label-ink T3): bajelo-54-dixe684, bunade-42-fudu910, fotuje-06-fifa085, nimana-36-veco708, nimise-04-jove070 and pavuzo-79-zodu430 were LOOSENED, which this file otherwise never does. The transition-label ink fold became jar-faithful -- upstream folds TextBlockMarged's own UEmpty (the marged block, measuredWidth + 2*marginLabel, anchored at the reserved box corner: TextBlockMarged.java:79-87 + LimitFinder.java:159-162), not the floored DOT reservation at the text anchor. All six composites were ALREADY smaller than jar's by a SEPARATE mechanism, and the old over-wide fold was partly cancelling that; correcting it unmasks the residual. The rule is not in doubt: on bunade-42-fudu910 jar's own SVG puts its rightmost label box at 90.464 + 54.8125 = 145.2765 and its ink min at 25.72, extent 119.5565 against the 119.557 its declared 154.557 - 35 implies. The same commit took measure-composite-declared-size from 2454 to 2469 exact with zero exact->non-exact, and shape-match-report from 776/25695 to 779/25952. What remains on these six is a label-POSITION divergence (~0.165px on bunade), which is its own mission -- drive these entries down there, and do not loosen any entry again without an equivalent jar-verified account. T3 RE-PIN (2026-08-18, mission state-declared-size-fix/T3, decisions.md#D3): ported `ReadFilterMergeLines` (preproc2/ReadFilterMergeLines.java:57-81) at both its chain positions (`BlockUmlBuilder.ts`'s `buildBlockUmls`, matching `Preprocessor.java:50-54`; `IncludeExecutor.ts#executeIncludesub`, matching `TContext.java:661`) -- a trailing-`\` physical line now merges with the next before block splitting / command dispatch, as the jar does. duzazu-41-telu529 and vixobo-14-jole910's `Active` composite HEIGHT rows are now byte-exact (were the G3 mechanism: 3 dropped continuation lines under `state Active { Active: SEND_MSG (...) / \` never reached `measureAutonomWrapper`'s description text at all). Each fixture's entry TIGHTENED, not removed: a residual WIDTH-only delta remains (duzazu-41 0.311805 -> 0.194444in; vixobo-14 0.388889 -> 0.194444in), confirmed by direct probe of the merged content (`buildBlockUmls` output matches entry/exit's already-correct `\n\t` pattern byte-for-byte) that the join itself is correct and `measureLines`/`splitStateDisplayLines` (shared by `state-sizing.ts` and `state-composite-sizing.ts`) receive it -- so this residual is the SAME class of gap as fibudu-53-bode309's #b row below (`measureAutonomWrapper`'s width computation, not the merge), out of T3's write-set. fibudu-53-bode309's #a row (the same merge mechanism, `attribute-line.md`) is likewise now exact; its #b row (0.388888 -> 0.173785in) is the pre-identified T6 residual, left untouched per the batch overview. T6 RE-PIN (2026-08-18, mission state-declared-size-fix/T6, decisions.md#D1/D5): state display/description/field text now routes through the ONE core creole seam (`src/core/svek/image/creole-text-lines.ts` via `src/diagrams/state/state-sizing-creole.ts`), matching `EntityImageStateCommon.java:80-81`'s `create8(nameFc, ..., CreoleMode.FULL, getStyleState().wrapWidth())` and `EntityImageState.java:98-99`'s identical fields call; `<<O-O>>` reserves `2*smallRadius + smallMarginY` = 10px on BOTH axes before `atLeast` (`EntityImageState.java:71,74,107-112`); a composite's own description lays out a real `StripeTable`/`AtomTable` grid (`StripeTable.java:82`'s `AtomWithMargin(table, 2, 2)`). SIXTEEN entries went to 0 and were DELETED (dogeji-46-sapo750, feziva-71-gufo538, fibudu-53-bode309, jafazu-60-leca675, kinuca-03-nice683, kubona-45-boso556, mefici-97-tudu030, mujipe-99-fume794, nixoja-06-guxe431, papifi-44-caxo706, rejike-58-rote606, resido-15-reza040, rijoki-89-teno556, rovado-96-boda672, viguto-81-gana093, xasoka-58-temi462); lokija-02-dipe348 tightened 1.189757 -> 1e-06 (one 6dp-inch quantization unit, the band this suite's own comment already admits) and mosigo-88-rove013 0.035764 -> 0.002284. juvagu-33-dupa212 is NOT re-pinned and its entry is NOT loosened: its tab stop is now byte-exact (jar's own SVG draws the superscript at x=68, i.e. tab stop 56, which this port reproduces), but `<sup>`/`<sub>` are unported anywhere in this port (`CommandCreoleBuilder.java:104-105,111` registers `CommandCreoleExposantChange`, which has no TS counterpart, and `FontConfiguration` has no `FontPosition` concept at all -- `EntityImageDescriptionDelegates.ts:147`), so the literal 12-character `<sup>1</sup>` now sits AFTER a correct 56px tab advance instead of before it. Closing it is a core creole feature outside T6's write-set; see the T6 row of plans/state-declared-size-fix/decision-journal.md. T5 RE-PIN (2026-08-18, mission state-declared-size-fix/T5, decisions.md#D5): fixing G10 (state-parse-resolve.ts's applyDeclaredContent -- a dotted leaf declared without `as` was clobbering its correctly-split display back to the full dotted id, widening its measured text) tightened fovafu-44-mifu394's scope-1 leaf-width rows and tubojo-49-tudu915's scope-1 rows (all now byte-exact, 0.080382 -> 0 -- tubojo-49-tudu915 REMOVED below) but PROPAGATES into fovafu-44-mifu394's still-unresolved scope-2 wrapper (plans/state-declared-size-diagnosis/findings/other.md#fovafu-44-mifu394%23b, `measureAutonomWrapper`, out of T5's write-set): the narrower leaf shrinks scope-2's width delta (7.714224px -> 4.179528px, improved) but WIDENS its height delta (10.594224px -> 11.996136px, 0.147142 -> 0.166613in), because B's own recursive wrapper measurement depends on A's now-narrower cluster. Loosened tighten-elsewhere: this entry is now bound by the #b residual alone, not by the (now-fixed) G10 leaf-width bug. Batch 5 (fovafu #b) inherits the new value. JUVAGU-33 RE-PIN (2026-08-18, mission state-declared-size-fix/T6, human ruling in decision-journal batch-2): juvagu-33-dupa212 LOOSENED 0.489844 -> 1.160677in. T6 made the AtomText tab-stop advance jar-exact (jar's own in.svg draws this description's superscript at x=68 = tab stop 56 + margins, which we now reproduce), which moved the still-literal `<sup>1</sup>` text (89.69px, 12 chars) AFTER a correct 56px advance instead of before it: 56 + 6.119 (jar's 11pt '1') + 20 = 82.119 = jar's declared box exactly, so the entire residual is the unported <sup>/<sub> creole command (CommandCreoleBuilder.java:104-105,111 registers CommandCreoleExposantChange -> FontPosition EXPOSANT/INDICE, FontPosition.java mute=size-3 clamp 2 / getSpace -6/+3; this port's FontConfiguration.ts has no fontPosition and CommandCreoleBuilder.ts never registers the command). Not a sizing regression: an unmasked pre-existing gap, tracked as the follow-on mission creole-exposant-port. Drive this entry down there; do not loosen again without an equivalent jar-verified account.
